summary: Jackson Hole Airport (JAC) is the only commercial airport located within a U.S. national park, situated on the doorstep of Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. Sitting at an elevation of approximately 6,447 feet, it offers passengers one of the most scenic commercial approaches in North America, with dramatic views of the Teton Range on final descent. The airport serves as the primary gateway for travelers visiting Jackson Hole, Grand Teton, and Yellowstone National Park.
faqs:
Q: Why is Jackson Hole Airport famous for its approach?
A: Passengers flying into JAC are treated to breathtaking views of the Grand Teton mountain range as the aircraft descends, often flying between the peaks. This approach is widely considered one of the most spectacular in commercial aviation and is a highlight for many visitors.

Q: What airlines serve Jackson Hole Airport?
A: JAC is served by several major carriers including American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, and seasonal service from others, with flights connecting primarily through hub airports like Salt Lake City, Denver, and Chicago.

Q: Does Jackson Hole Airport operate year-round?
A: Yes, JAC operates year-round, but flight frequency increases significantly during the winter ski season and summer national park tourism months, while service may be reduced in shoulder seasons.

Q: How large is Jackson Hole Airport?
A: Despite its medium classification, JAC has a single main runway and a compact terminal, handling around 500,000+ passengers annually.
transport_tips: Rental cars are the most popular option for reaching Jackson and the surrounding parks, with major agencies located on-site. During winter, the road between the airport and town can be snowy, so consider booking a vehicle with all-wheel drive. Shuttle services and taxis are available but should be reserved in advance during peak seasons.
local_tip: Request a window seat on the left side of the aircraft when flying into JAC for the best views of the Tetons during landing, and plan to have your camera ready roughly 10 minutes before touchdown.
